newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka troops capture key northern rebel town.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka troops capture key northern rebel town.

text.p: Sri Lankan troops captured a key rebel town on Monday after resuming their offensive in the northern Wanni region controlled by Tamil Tiger rebels, military officials in the north said.
They said troops of Operation "Jaya Sikuru", or "Sure of Victory" captured Puliyankulam, some 22 km (14 miles) north of the government-held town of Vavuniya.
Sri Lanka troops capture key northern rebel town
Military officials said troops were backed by tanks, artillery and air force cover. Rebel resistence was not heavy, they added.
Troops moved out of their camps in the Wanni region on two flanks on Monday in an attempt to converge at Puliyankulam, which was held by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels.

The LTTE are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east. The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
